chunks.ar: كانت ثلاث سمكات تعيش في بركة هادئة بين الأشجار.
chunks.en_old: Three fish lived in a quiet pond among the trees.
chunks.en_new: Three fish lived in a quiet pond among the trees.

chunks.ar: كان هناك نهر قريب، يصل إلى البركة بمجرى صغير.
chunks.en_old: A nearby river was connected to the pond by a narrow stream.
chunks.en_new: There was a river nearby, joined to the pond by a small stream.

chunks.ar: نادرًا ما جاء الناس إلى هذا المكان، فكانت السمكات تسبح مطمئنة كل يوم.
chunks.en_old: People rarely came to that place, so the fish swam peacefully every day.
chunks.en_new: People rarely came to that place, so the fish swam peacefully every day.

chunks.ar: كانت السمكة الأولى حكيمة وسريعة القرار،
chunks.en_old: The first fish was wise and quick to decide.
chunks.en_new: The first fish was wise and quick to decide.

chunks.ar: والثانية ذكية لكنها تتردد أحيانًا،
chunks.en_old: The second was clever but sometimes hesitated.
chunks.en_new: The second was clever but sometimes hesitated.

chunks.ar: أما الثالثة فلم تكن تفكر في الأخطار.
chunks.en_old: The third rarely thought about danger.
chunks.en_new: As for the third, she never thought about danger.

chunks.ar: ورغم اختلافها، عاشت السمكات الثلاث معًا في البركة.
chunks.en_old: Despite their differences, the three fish lived together in the pond.
chunks.en_new: Despite their differences, the three fish lived together in the pond.

chunks.ar: في أحد الأيام، مرّ صيادان قرب الماء.
chunks.en_old: One day, two fishermen passed by the water.
chunks.en_new: One day, two fishermen passed by the water.

chunks.ar: نظر أحدهما إلى البركة وقال: «انظر إلى هذه الأسماك!
chunks.en_old: One looked into the pond and said, “Look at those fish!
chunks.en_new: One looked into the pond and said, “Look at those fish!

chunks.ar: سنعود غدًا بالشباك ونصطادها.»
chunks.en_old: We will come back tomorrow with nets and catch them.”
chunks.en_new: We will come back tomorrow with nets and catch them.”

chunks.ar: سمعت السمكات كلام الرجلين، وشعرت بالخوف.
chunks.en_old: The fish heard the men and became afraid.
chunks.en_new: The fish heard the men and became afraid.

chunks.ar: قالت السمكة الأولى: «لن أنتظر عودتهما.»
chunks.en_old: “I will not wait for them to return,” said the first fish.
chunks.en_new: “I will not wait for them to return,” said the first fish.

chunks.ar: سبحت فورًا عبر المجرى الضيق، ووصلت إلى النهر الواسع.
chunks.en_old: She immediately swam through the narrow stream into the wide river.
chunks.en_new: She immediately swam through the narrow stream into the wide river.

chunks.ar: هناك وجدت مكانًا آمنًا بعيدًا عن الشباك.
chunks.en_old: There she found a safe place far from the nets.
chunks.en_new: There she found a safe place far from the nets.

chunks.ar: أما السمكة الثانية فقالت: «لدينا وقت حتى الغد.»
chunks.en_old: The second fish said, “We have until tomorrow.”
chunks.en_new: The second fish said, “We have until tomorrow.”

chunks.ar: بقيت في البركة تبحث عن خطة.
chunks.en_old: She stayed in the pond, looking for a plan.
chunks.en_new: She stayed in the pond, looking for a plan.

chunks.ar: وأما الثالثة فقالت: «لا تقلقا! ربما لن يعود الصيادان أصلًا.»
chunks.en_old: The third said, “Do not worry! Perhaps the fishermen will not come back at all.”
chunks.en_new: The third said, “Do not worry! Perhaps the fishermen will not come back at all.”

chunks.ar: ثم واصلت السباحة واللعب.
chunks.en_old: Then she carried on swimming and playing.
chunks.en_new: Then she carried on swimming and playing.

chunks.ar: لكن الصيادين عادا في الصباح ومعهما شباك كبيرة.
chunks.en_old: But the fishermen returned in the morning with large nets.
chunks.en_new: But the fishermen returned in the morning with large nets.

chunks.ar: أغلقا المجرى المؤدي إلى النهر.
chunks.en_old: They blocked the stream leading to the river.
chunks.en_new: They blocked the stream leading to the river.

chunks.ar: حاولت السمكة الثانية الهرب، لكنها وجدت الطريق مسدودًا.
chunks.en_old: The second fish tried to escape but found the way closed.
chunks.en_new: The second fish tried to escape but found the way closed.

chunks.ar: عندئذ فكرت بسرعة في حيلة أخيرة.
chunks.en_old: Then she quickly thought of one last trick.
chunks.en_new: Then she quickly thought of one last trick.

chunks.ar: استلقت السمكة الثانية على ظهرها، وتركت جسمها يطفو بلا حركة.
chunks.en_old: The second fish rolled onto her back and let her body float without moving.
chunks.en_new: The second fish rolled onto her back and let her body float without moving.

chunks.ar: ظن الصيادان أنها ميتة، فأخرجاها من الماء ووضعاها قرب النهر.
chunks.en_old: The fishermen thought she was dead, took her out, and placed her near the river.
chunks.en_new: The fishermen thought she was dead, took her out, and placed her near the river.

chunks.ar: فجأة، قفزت إلى الماء وسبحت بعيدًا.
chunks.en_old: Suddenly, she jumped into the water and swam away.
chunks.en_new: Suddenly, she jumped into the water and swam away.

chunks.ar: أما السمكة الثالثة فسبحت في كل اتجاه، ولم تعرف أين تختبئ.
chunks.en_old: The third fish darted in every direction, unable to find a hiding place.
chunks.en_new: The third fish swam in every direction and did not know where to hide.
chunks.note: closer to 'did not know where to hide'

chunks.ar: وقعت أخيرًا في شبكة الصيادين.
chunks.en_old: At last, she was caught in the fishermen’s net.
chunks.en_new: At last, she was caught in the fishermen’s net.

chunks.ar: وفي النهر الواسع، كانت السمكتان الأخريان تسبحان بحرية، بعيدًا عن البركة القديمة.
chunks.en_old: In the wide river, the other two fish swam freely, far from their old pond.
chunks.en_new: In the wide river, the other two fish swam freely, far from their old pond.
